description: Utility module providing helper functions for URL and header processing, as well as AWS Bedrock model ID encoding, used in a larger codebase related to passthrough request handling.

classes.name: BasePassthroughUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for merging URL query parameters and forwarding headers in HTTP requests.

classes.name: CommonUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility method for encoding AWS Bedrock Runtime model ARNs in endpoint URLs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Union[str,List[str]]] get_merged_query_parameters( existing_url: httpx.URL, request_query_params: Dict[str, Union[str, list]] )
methods.description: Merges existing URL query parameters with request query parameters, giving priority to existing URL parameters.

methods.name: forward_headers_from_request( request_headers: dict, headers: dict, forward_headers: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Forwards headers from the original request to a new headers dict, optionally removing certain headers.

methods.name: str encode_bedrock_runtime_modelid_arn(endpoint: str)
methods.description: Encodes slashes within AWS ARNs in Bedrock runtime endpoints so they are treated as single path segments, avoiding server errors.

ctags.signature: ( request_headers: dict, headers: dict, forward_headers: Optional[bool] = False, )
